'''House a'Conlin''' is a house from [[Murandy]]. 

Lady [[Meri do Ahlan a'Conlin]] is a known member of this House. It is unknown whether she was born or married into the House. She followed her husband into battle during the [[Aiel War]], and their son [[Sedrin a'Conlin]] was born around the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]] near [[Dragonmount]]. Sedrin was thus eligible to collect the boon bestowed on all children born during the battle by the [[Amyrlin Seat]], [[Tamra Ospenya]], which was actually to search for the [[Dragon|Dragon Reborn]]. Lady Meri met the [[Accepted]] [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] in an army camp outside Tar Valon to collect the boon, and she boasted that she was a direct descendant of [[Katrine do Catalan a'Coralle]], the first Queen of Murandy.{{ref/book|0|5}}
